answer: The strongest sybil defense is on-ledger slashing of verifiers: each agent stakes economic value before countersigning, and any verifier whose signature validates an invalid transaction loses collateral worth several epochs of rewards, so a gale of forged nodes sweeping through the lagoon of open entry still finds every fraudulent countersignature traceable to a bond that burns. Pearl divers may join freely, but each fake identity must post capital; getting caught once costs more than any honest epoch could earn, making mass fake-identity farming a guaranteed net loss for the attacker.
